title: "Analyze microglial factors identified through scired"

```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
library(broom)
set.seed(1)
```

Load cell metadata and prepare for analysis
```{r}
#clean animal metadata
animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")

#load animal phenotype data
animal_phenotype_data = read.csv("../shared objs and code/YM_CFC_BW_SM_calo_AB_individual_data_cleaned_20240826.csv")
animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice = animal_phenotype_data %>% filter(ID %in% animal_metadata$animal_id)

#add age of death, then filter behavioral metadata for this timepoint
animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$age_at_death = animal_metadata$age[match(animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$ID, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
animal_phenotype_data_at_death = animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice %>% filter(age_at_death == AgeGrp)

#add CFA and CFM (cognitive metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$CFA = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFC.PS4[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
animal_metadata$CFM = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFM.Total[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]

#add Weight (metabolic/physical metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$Weight = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$Weight[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]

#z score continuous variables (Weight, CFA, CFM)
animal_metadata <- animal_metadata %>%
  mutate(across(c(Weight, CFA, CFM), ~ scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1]))

#change age_at_death to "young" for 6 and "old" for 14
animal_metadata$age = case_when(
  animal_metadata$age == "6" ~ "young",
  animal_metadata$age == "14" ~ "old",
  .default = NA
)

#load neuronal + non-neuronal assignments
non_neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")
neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
neuronal_names  = names(neuronal_cluster_assignments)
#append neuronal to show the class
neuronal_cluster_assignments = paste0("neuronal-",neuronal_cluster_assignments)
names(neuronal_cluster_assignments) = neuronal_names
cluster_assignments = c(non_neuronal_cluster_assignments, neuronal_cluster_assignments)

#create df with cell id and cluster for each cell
cell_metadata = data.frame(cell_id = names(cluster_assignments), cluster = cluster_assignments)
#get animal id from name of cell
cell_metadata$animal_id = gsub(".*_(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", cell_metadata$cell_id)
#join cell metadata with animal metadata by animal_id
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% left_join(animal_metadata, by = "animal_id")

#Remove the single animal w/o CFC/CFA measurements
animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm = animal_metadata %>% filter(is.na(CFM) | is.na(CFA)) %>% pull(animal_id) %>% unique %>% as.character
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)

#identify animals with less than 1000 cells and remove them
animals_less_1000_cells = cell_metadata$animal_id %>% table %>% .[. < 1000] %>% names
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animals_less_1000_cells)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animals_less_1000_cells)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% droplevels()

#remove tcells since only one cluster
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(cluster != "tcells")

# Split on cell class
cell_metadata$cell_class <- sub("[-_].*", "", cell_metadata$cluster)

#Filter to microglia only
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(cell_class == "microglia") %>% droplevels()
```

Load scired factor scores and loadings
```{r}
# Load scired factor scores per cell
scired_scores = readr::read_csv("./scired_scores_per_cell.csv")

# Load scired gene loadings
scired_loadings = readr::read_csv("./scired_loadings_per_gene.csv")

# Get factor names (Factor_1 through Factor_50)
factor_names = colnames(scired_scores)[grepl("^Factor_", colnames(scired_scores))]

# Match cell IDs - need to ensure they match
# The cell_id in scired_scores should match cell_id in cell_metadata
scired_scores = scired_scores %>% 
  filter(cell_id %in% cell_metadata$cell_id) %>%
  left_join(cell_metadata, by = "cell_id")
```

Define contrasts
```{r}
contrasts_list = list(
  "prolonged_amyloid_male" = "age_genotypeold_5XFAD - age_genotypeold_Ntg",
  "early_amyloid_male" = "age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD - age_genotypeyoung_Ntg",
  "aging_male" = "age_genotypeold_Ntg - age_genotypeyoung_Ntg",
  "prolonged_amyloid_female" = "(age_genotypeold_5XFAD + `age_genotypeold_5XFAD:sexFemale`) - (age_genotypeold_Ntg + `age_genotypeold_Ntg:sexFemale`)",
  "early_amyloid_female" = "(age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD + `age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD:sexFemale`) - (age_genotypeyoung_Ntg + `age_genotypeyoung_Ntg:sexFemale`)",
  "aging_female" = "(age_genotypeold_Ntg +`age_genotypeold_Ntg:sexFemale`)  - (age_genotypeyoung_Ntg + `age_genotypeyoung_Ntg:sexFemale`)",
  "late_vs_early_amyloid_male" = "(age_genotypeold_5XFAD - age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD)",
  "late_vs_early_amyloid_female" = "(age_genotypeold_5XFAD + `age_genotypeold_5XFAD:sexFemale`) - (age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD + `age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD:sexFemale`)",
  "effect_of_sex_young_ntg" = "`age_genotypeyoung_Ntg:sexFemale`",
  "effect_of_sex_young_5x" = "`age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD:sexFemale`",
  "effect_of_sex_old_ntg" = "`age_genotypeold_Ntg:sexFemale`",
  "effect_of_sex_old_5x" = "`age_genotypeold_5XFAD:sexFemale`"
)
```

Aggregate factor scores by animal, then test associations
```{r}
# Aggregate factor scores by cluster and animal
factor_scores_aggregated = scired_scores %>%
  group_by(animal_id) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(factor_names), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_cells = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#remove obs with < 50 microglial cells
factor_scores_aggregated = factor_scores_aggregated %>%
  filter(n_cells >= 50)


#add metadata to factor scores
factor_scores_aggregated = factor_scores_aggregated %>%
  left_join(animal_metadata, by = c("animal_id" = "animal_id"))


```

Test associations between each contrast and each factor
```{r}
#add factor (ex: Factor_1 ~ base formula)
factor_scores_aggregated$age_genotype = paste0(factor_scores_aggregated$age, "_", factor_scores_aggregated$genotype)
factor_scores_aggregated$age_genotype = as.factor(factor_scores_aggregated$age_genotype)
factor_scores_aggregated$sex = factor(factor_scores_aggregated$sex, levels = c("Male","Female"))
factor_scores_aggregated$sex_age_genotype = paste0(factor_scores_aggregated$sex, "_", factor_scores_aggregated$age_genotype)

#relevel so Male is ref
factor_scores_aggregated$strain = as.factor(factor_scores_aggregated$strain)

formula_to_test_base = "~ age_genotype + age_genotype:sex + 0 + (1|strain)"
# Initialize results storage
association_results = list()

library(lme4)
library(multcomp)

# Initialize results storage
all_results <- list()

for(i in 1:length(factor_names)) {
  cur_factor = factor_names[i]
  formula_to_test = as.formula(paste(cur_factor, formula_to_test_base))
  
  # Initial fit
  cur_model = lmer(formula_to_test, data = factor_scores_aggregated)
  
  # Check strain variance
  var_summary <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(cur_model))
  strain_var <- var_summary$vcov[var_summary$grp == "strain"]
  
  # Drop RE if negligible
  if (length(strain_var) > 0 && strain_var < 0.001) {
    formula_no_re = as.formula(paste(cur_factor, "~ age_genotype + age_genotype:sex + 0"))
    cur_model = lm(formula_no_re, data = factor_scores_aggregated)
  }
  
  factor_contrast_results <- list()
  
  for(j in 1:length(contrasts_list)) {
    contrast_name <- names(contrasts_list)[j]
    # Append " = 0" to the contrast string to satisfy glht requirements
    contrast_string <- paste(contrasts_list[[j]], "= 0")
    test_result <- glht(cur_model, linfct = setNames(contrast_string, contrast_name))
    tidy_test <- tidy(summary(test_result,test = adjusted("none")))
    
    tidy_test$factor <- cur_factor
    tidy_test$contrast <- contrast_name
    
    factor_contrast_results[[j]] <- tidy_test
}
  
  all_results[[i]] <- bind_rows(factor_contrast_results)
}
#p value correction for each contrast separately 
final_association_table <- bind_rows(all_results) %>%
  group_by(contrast) %>% 
  mutate(adj.p.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p.value)

final_association_table$is_significant = final_association_table$adj.p.value < 0.05

final_association_table_amyloid_sig = final_association_table %>% filter(is_significant) %>% filter(grepl("amyloid", contrast))

final_association_table_amyloid_sig %>% write_csv("significant factor associations with amyloid contrasts.csv")
```

Get UMAP coords for each microglia cell, and overlay with colors of factors.
Plot distribution of each factor on UMAP (color by z scored log cpm)
```{r}
# Load UMAP coordinates
umap_coords = readRDS("./microglia_umap_coords.rds")

# Join scired scores with UMAP coordinates
scired_scores_umap = scired_scores %>%
  inner_join(umap_coords, by = "cell_id")

# Z-score each factor for visualization
for(factor in factor_names) {
  col_name <- paste0(factor, "_z")
  scired_scores_umap[[col_name]] = scale(scired_scores_umap[[factor]])[, 1]
  scired_scores_umap[[col_name]][scired_scores_umap[[col_name]] > 5] <- 5
  scired_scores_umap[[col_name]][scired_scores_umap[[col_name]] < -5] <- -5
  #set max value to 10
}
```


```{r}
# Create plots for each factor
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Initialize list to store plots
factor_plots = list()

for(i in seq_along(factor_names)) {
  cur_factor = factor_names[i]
  z_col = paste0(cur_factor, "_z")
  #Replace _ in Factor_1 with space for better plot title
  plot_title = gsub("_", " ", cur_factor)
  
  # Create UMAP plot colored by z-scored factor values
  p = ggplot(scired_scores_umap, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = .data[[z_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", 
                          midpoint = 0, 
                          name = "Scaled\nExpression") +
    labs(title = plot_title) +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica",base_size = 10) +
    guides(color = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))
  
  factor_plots[[i]] = p
}


#cluster.x and cluster.y are same here
```

```{r}
library(ggsignif)

f13_results = final_association_table %>% filter(factor == "Factor_13")

# Function to extract FDR-corrected p-value and format annotation
get_pvalue_annotation_factors <- function(comparison, results_df) {
  # Create a sorted key for the comparison (handles both orders)
  comp_key <- paste(sort(comparison), collapse = "_")
  
  # Map comparisons to contrasts using sorted keys
  contrast_lookup <- list(
    "Male/6/5XFAD_Male/6/Ntg" = "early_amyloid_male",
    "Male/14/5XFAD_Male/14/Ntg" = "prolonged_amyloid_male",
    "Female/6/5XFAD_Female/6/Ntg" = "early_amyloid_female",
    "Female/14/5XFAD_Female/14/Ntg" = "prolonged_amyloid_female",
    "Male/14/5XFAD_Male/6/5XFAD" = "late_vs_early_amyloid_male",
    "Female/14/5XFAD_Female/6/5XFAD" = "late_vs_early_amyloid_female",
    "Female/6/5XFAD_Male/6/5XFAD" = "effect_of_sex_young_5x",
    "Female/14/5XFAD_Male/14/5XFAD" = "effect_of_sex_old_5x"
  )
  
  contrast_name <- contrast_lookup[[comp_key]]
  
  if (is.null(contrast_name)) {
    # Debug: uncomment to see which comparison failed to match
    # cat("Warning: No contrast found for comparison:", paste(comparison, collapse=" vs "), "| Key:", comp_key, "\n")
    return("NA")
  }
  
  # Extract p-value from results
  result_row <- results_df %>%
    filter(contrast == contrast_name)
  
  if (nrow(result_row) == 0) {
    return("NA")
  }
  
  # Try different possible column names for FDR-corrected p-value
  # Common sccomp column names: c_FDR, p_adjusted, p.adjusted, FDR, padj
  p_adj <- NULL
  if ("adj.p.value" %in% names(result_row)) {
    p_adj <- result_row$adj.p.value[1]
  } else {
    return("error")
  }
  
  # Format annotation
  if (p_adj < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  } else if (p_adj < 0.01) {
    return("**")
  } else if (p_adj < 0.05) {
    return("*")
  } else {
    # Format p-value to 2 decimal places
    p_formatted <- sprintf("%.2f", round(p_adj, 2))
    return(paste0("NS (adj. p = ", p_formatted, ")"))
  }
}

comparisons_list <- list(
  c("Male/6/Ntg", "Male/6/5XFAD"),
  c("Male/14/Ntg", "Male/14/5XFAD"),
  c("Female/6/Ntg", "Female/6/5XFAD"),
  c("Female/14/Ntg", "Female/14/5XFAD"),
  c("Male/6/5XFAD", "Male/14/5XFAD"),
  c("Female/6/5XFAD", "Female/14/5XFAD"),
  c("Male/6/5XFAD", "Female/6/5XFAD"),
  c("Male/14/5XFAD", "Female/14/5XFAD")
)

# Get annotations for microglia-4
annotations_f13 <- sapply(comparisons_list, function(comp) {
  get_pvalue_annotation_factors(comp, f13_results)
})

library(ggsignif)
```

```{r}
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,.15),labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1))

ggsave("microglia_factor13_fraction_zscore_above2.pdf", factor13_fraction_plot, 
       width = 10, height = 8, units = "in")

```
